results.title: Kofi Adams pledges $10,000 bonus for each Black Challenge player after Amputee World Cup triumph
results.content: Ghana defeated Morocco 1-0 in Sunday’s final to lift the trophy and become world champions, with an own goal in the second half proving decisive.

results.title: Banks poised to drive New Economy, says ADB MD
results.content: The Managing Director of Agricultural Development Bank PLC (ADB), Edward Ato Sarpong, has highlighted the critical role of Ghana’s banking sector in driving the country’s new economy.

results.title: GREDA boss explains why private hostels cost more than traditional halls
results.content: The cost of operating privately financed student hostels cannot be fairly compared with charges at traditional university halls, which were mostly built decades ago and no longer carry the original construction costs, the Executive Director of the Ghana Real Estate Developers Association (GREDA), Samuel Amegayibor, has said.

results.title: Gold Fields defends Ghana operations, says 74% of every dollar generated stays in country
results.content: The Senior Vice President and Managing Director of Gold Fields Ghana Limited, Elliot Twum, defended the company’s contribution to Ghana’s economy, saying 74 per cent of every dollar generated from its operations stays in the country.

results.title: Gold Fields eyes $7.5bn investment in Tarkwa Mine as lease expiry looms
results.content: Gold Fields Ghana Limited is planning a $7.5 billion investment in its Tarkwa Mine over the next two decades as it seeks to renew its mining leases, which expire in April 2027.

results.content: Acting Rent Commissioner, Frederick Opoku

results.title: Past Ghana’s Most Beautiful contestant Ohemaa Sappama found dead
results.content: A former contestant of TV3’s Ghana’s Most Beautiful (GMB) pageant, Ohemaa Sappama Angela, popularly known as Ohemaa GMB, has reportedly been found dead in her room.

results.title: Cape Coast Castle Museum remains closed seven years after deterioration
results.content: Seven years after the main museum gallery at Cape Coast Castle was closed due to dilapidation, the facility remains locked and continues to deteriorate, affecting tourism at the historic site.

results.title: Premature BECE candidates face two-year ban from re-sitting exam
results.content: Form One and Two students who register early for the Basic Education Certificate Examination (BECE) will be barred from re-sitting the exam for two years, Mr Haruna Iddrisu, Minister of Education, announced.

results.title: Some student hostel fees too high, out of order – GREDA boss agrees with Rent Control
results.content: The Executive Director of the Ghana Real Estate Developers Association (GREDA), Samuel Amegayibor, has admitted that some student hostel charges in Ghana are excessive and cannot be justified by the quality of facilities provided.

results.title: UGEL hostel dispute: No free pass for investors – Rent Commissioner declares
results.content: The Acting Rent Commissioner, Frederick Opoku, has warned private hostel operators and university-linked accommodation providers that investment in student housing does not place them beyond the reach of Ghana’s rent laws.

results.title: CAS to release Senegal Africa Cup of Nations title appeal decision today
results.content: The Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS) will release its decision on Tuesday, November 24, on Senegal's appeal against being stripped of this year's Africa Cup of Nations title, the court said.

results.title: GREDA proposes star-rating system for student hostels to address exorbitant fees
results.content: The Ghana Real Estate Developers Association (GREDA) has proposed a star-rating system for student hostels to enable students assess the quality of accommodation facilities before paying for them.

results.title: Galamsey threatens Sunyani’s water supply as PURC raises concerns over Tano River pollution
results.content: The Public Utilities Regulatory Commission (PURC) has raised concerns about rising illegal mining along the upper stretches of the Tano River, warning that the situation could worsen water supply challenges in Sunyani and surrounding communities.

results.title: Lending rates set for significant drop after BoG policy rate cut – Association of Banks
results.content: The Ghana Association of Banks (GAB) expects a significant reduction in lending rates in the coming months after the Bank of Ghana slashed its policy rate by 300 basis points.

results.title: Hostel fees traumatising students, parents – NUGS
results.content: The National Union of Ghana Students (NUGS) has called for urgent government intervention in the rising cost of student accommodation, warning that hostel charges are putting severe financial pressure on students and their families and threatening access to tertiary education.

results.title: Tullow Oil cuts cash flow forecast after settling $387m tax disputes with Ghana
results.content: Tullow Oil has lowered its 2026 free cash flow forecast after reaching an agreement with the Government of Ghana to settle two long-running tax disputes involving claims totalling $387 million.

results.title: Nigeria’s SEC approves Dangote refinery’s IPO share distribution plan, sources say
results.content: Nigeria's Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday approved Dangote Refinery's plan to allocate shares in its heavily oversubscribed initial public offering, which closed last month, three people familiar with the matter said.

results.title: Accra Mall to celebrate kids’ talent with Talent Showcase
results.content: This November, Accra Mall will spotlight young talent with its Kids' Talent Showcase on November 28, as part of its Family Fun programme.

results.title: The missing half of risk management: Why Ghana’s commodity businesses must embrace hedging
results.content: Ghanaian businesses have become fluent in the language of currency risk, tracking the cedi daily as large firms make FX hedging standard practice. Yet when they raise commodity price hedging in the same boardrooms, the conversation stalls.

results.title: ‘Customer experience must have a seat at the table’ – Marketing expert
results.content: Head of Brand and Marketing at Stanbic Bank Ghana, Chidinma Braye-Yankey, has urged businesses to give customers a stronger voice in corporate decision-making, stressing that customer insights should shape business outcomes rather than merely serve as feedback for management.

results.title: Pluralistic ignorance and the need to unlearn, learn, and relearn in Supply Chain Management
results.content: Pluralistic ignorance occurs when people privately question or reject a group norm but mistakenly believe that most others support it (Mendes, Lopez-Valeiras & Lunkes, 2017). Because each person remains silent, the group's false perception of consensus becomes self-reinforcing.

results.title: US lawmakers criticise Nvidia’s decision to reinstate Huang as CEO
results.content: US lawmakers from both parties sharply criticised Nvidia's decision to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO, saying Congress should tighten restrictions on China's ‌access to the company's advanced AI chips and scrutinise the circumstances surrounding Huang's return.

results.title: Trump administration sued over removal of slavery exhibit in Philadelphia
results.content: Advocacy groups sued US President Donald Trump's administration on Monday over the removal of ​a slavery exhibit in Philadelphia, arguing that it ‌was an instance of selective removal of Black history.

results.title: Hostel investors may take 30 years to recover costs – GREDA
results.content: Private developers investing in student accommodation may spend up to 30 years repaying the loans used to construct hostels, the Executive Director of the Ghana Real Estate Developers Association (GREDA), Samuel Amegayibor, has said.

results.title: ‘Let’s look at the issues realistically’ – Dr Kpeglo-Freiku on university housing crisis
results.content: The Executive Secretary of Vice Chancellors Ghana has called for a realistic, objective national discussion on the growing accommodation crisis in public universities, insisting the problem goes beyond individual institutions.

results.title: UG accommodation crisis reflects wider problems across public universities – Dr Kpeglo-Freiku
results.content: The accommodation crisis at the University of Ghana reflects deeper challenges confronting public universities across the country, Dr Cynthia Kpeglo-Freiku, Executive Secretary of Vice Chancellors Ghana, said.

results.title: High financing costs blocking private sector investment in student hostels – GREDA
results.content: Private investment could help ease Ghana’s growing shortage of student accommodation, but developers need access to affordable long-term financing, secure land and a predictable regulatory environment to make such projects viable, the Ghana Real Estate Developers Association (GREDA) has said.

results.title: University housing crisis only part of wider hardship facing students – Dr Kpeglo-Freiku
results.content: Dr Cynthia Kpeglo-Freiku, Executive Secretary of Vice Chancellors Ghana, says the growing accommodation crisis in public universities is only one part of the wider economic hardship confronting students nationwide.

results.title: Oil holds near three-month low as rising supply offsets Hormuz threat
results.content: Oil prices eased Tuesday, hovering near a three-month low amid concerns about rising crude supply and a potential market surplus, while risk to shipping through the Strait of Hormuz persisted.
